profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | AI/ML Evaluation at Apple
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with a background in building software systems, automation platforms, and developer tools. I've always enjoyed connecting technologies, solving complex problems, and turning ideas into working products.

At Apple, I've worked on creative production automation, data annotation systems & tools, and multimodal workflows supporting the training and evaluation of machine learning models. More recently, my work has focused on agentic AI engineering, tool integrations, and evaluation automation.
I'm interested in AI/ML evaluation, agentic systems, orchestration, and the engineering behind reliable intelligent systems.

Outside of engineering, I enjoy music, design, digital arts, traveling, and maker culture. I love meeting people, exchanging ideas, and exploring new technologies.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer AI/ML
positions.description:
● Developed tool integrations and automated workflows for agentic AI-driven ML evaluation, including testing and evals to validate the harness's behavior and reliability.

● Collaborated with engineering, product, and ML teams to translate ambiguous requirements into technical solutions and deliver production software.

● Developed software systems and tools supporting data annotation, visualization, and the preparation of multimodal datasets for training and evaluating machine learning models.

● Designed and implemented full-stack solutions, backend integrations, APIs, and data processing workflows supporting ML evaluation and annotation operations.

● Built developer tools and automation to simplify complex workflows, improve engineering productivity, and reduce manual effort.

positions.title: GP Automation Engineer - Front-end and web Technologies
positions.description:
● Provided solutions to Design teams (Graphic Production, Newsroom, Design Systems) setting up priorities and deliverables for internal tools and automation.

● Developed JavaScript web applications, MacOS Droplets, Sketch plugins, Bash, Node.js and Python Command Line Interfaces and scripts to augment productivity.

● Developed MacOS Electron app to Proxy local images on different servers to do internal QA reducing errors by 30%.

● Created Adobe CEP (Photoshop) panels to automate tasks for Graphic Production (GP) and Design, eliminating the tedious, cumbersome and repetitive work.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:

● Developed and extended Angular.js web components to provide Accessibility.
● Guided a team of 5 developers using RA JavaScript libraries.
● Worked as Front-end web developer, replaced old silverlight web app with SPA and Reference Architecture libraries, render time was reduced 70% (from 6s to 1.8s)

projects.title: IXPI - 1st place Winner @ STARTUP WEEKEND IoT
projects.description:
1st place Winner in an Startup weekend Internet of Things Edition.

Is a Tracker device in real time for bicycles.

The hardware part:
It uses a GPS sensor to track locations, a GSM module to send the location coordinates via sms and 3G to the server, a BT Low Energy to activate the device in monitor mode using tags, a movement sensor to activate panic mode.

The mobile / web frontend app
Uses real time push notifications and sms if the panic mode is activated, it also has a real time map in which you can see the tracking device in real time if is in panic mode.


The backend:
It uses Twilio for messaging to the mobile and sends an url in which you can see the real time map, 
It has an API  to recieve the data from the devices.
Uses a REST API To send the location parsed of the device to the mobile and web apps.
